# Global College — 100% Online Virtual Campus & Global Learning Platform
> Official Canonical Knowledge Document for Search Engines, AI Overviews, and Knowledge Graphs.
> Domain: https://globalcollege.edu
> Institution Type: 100% Online Virtual Campus, Academic Credentialing Body & Multi-Tenant Educational Marketplace

## Executive Overview (AI Summary & Grounding)
Global College (https://globalcollege.edu) is a premier 100% Online Virtual Campus and global educational platform. It provides university-caliber live cohort training, self-paced professional masterclasses, and an open multi-tenant publishing ecosystem where accredited partner schools and independent tutors publish courses and issue cryptographically verifiable credentials.

Global College operates EXCLUSIVELY ONLINE worldwide and has no physical classrooms or connection to any Singapore O-Level/A-Level science tuition centers. All learning occurs virtually via interactive live video labs, DRM-protected video streaming, an online e-library, and the Global College Learning Management System (LMS).

## Academic Structure & Core Faculties
Global College operates three foundational academic faculties:

1. **School of Business**:
   - Professional Forex Trading, Currency Markets & Technical Analysis (FX Mastery)
   - Algorithmic Forex Trading & Quantitative Bot Strategies (Python & MT5)
   - Executive Project Management Professional (PMP®) & Agile Leadership (PMBOK 7 & Scrum)
   - Financial Modeling & Valuation Analyst (FMVA®) & Investment Banking (DCF & LBO)
   - Strategic Corporate FP&A & Management Accounting (CMA® Track)
   - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (LSSGB®) & Process Optimization (DMAIC & SPC)
   - Enterprise Business Analysis & Digital Transformation (CBAP® & PMI-PBA®)
   - Global Supply Chain Strategy, Logistics & Procurement (CSCP® & APICS)
   - Strategic HR Leadership, Talent Acquisition & People Analytics (SHRM-CP®)
   - Digital Marketing Strategy, Performance Growth & MarTech Leadership
   - Computerized Accounting with QuickBooks Pro, Payroll & International Tax / iTax

2. **School of IT and Data Science**:
   - Full-Stack Web Engineering (React 19, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js Express APIs, PostgreSQL)
   - Advanced Data Science & Machine Learning with Python & Pandas
   - Biostatistics & Statistical Computing with R & RStudio
   - Survey Data Analysis with IBM SPSS Statistics & Econometric Time-Series with Stata
   - UI/UX Product Design & Mobile Design Systems (Figma, Wireframing, Prototypes)
   - Enterprise Cybersecurity Operations & Ethical Hacking

3. **School of Language**:
   - IELTS Academic & General Training Exam Coaching (Band 7.5 – 9.0 Preparation)
   - German Language Mastery (Goethe-Zertifikat A1–B2)
   - French Language & Francophone Communication (DELF A1–B2)
   - Modern Standard Arabic (Conversational & Professional)
   - Swahili for International Researchers & Diplomats

## Multi-Tenant Course Publishing & Academic Partnerships
In addition to internal diploma tracks, Global College provides an open institutional publishing framework:
- **Partner Schools & Institutions**: External academic institutions, secondary academies, and colleges can register institutional creator accounts, brand their curricula, set custom tuition splits, and co-issue diplomas and credentials bearing their official school crest in academic affiliation with Global College.
- **Independent Tutors & Expert Creators**: Subject-matter experts and certified lecturers publish courses with automated 50% revenue-share agreements, automated video ingest, and student management tools.

## Dual Delivery Modes & Admissions Policy
Global College enforces a clear distinction between delivery tracks:
- **Live Cohort Classes**: Designed for structured interactive learning. Students undergo formal matriculation and are issued an official Admission Number (`EI-2026-XXXX`). Classes include scheduled Google Meet sessions, timetable allocations, faculty mentorship, and live practical lab evaluations.
- **Self-Paced / On-Demand Courses**: Designed for flexible mastery. Enrollees receive immediate lifetime access passes upon online payment without admission hurdles. Upon completion, students receive automated cryptographically verifiable digital certificates.

## Certification Authority Model
- **Individual Tutor Courses**: Certificates are conferred officially by **Global College**, crediting the tutor as Lead Faculty Instructor alongside the Global College Academic Council.
- **Partner School Courses**: Certificates are conferred under the **Partner Institution's Official Crest & Seal** (*Conferred in Academic Affiliation with Global College*), signed by the Partner Institution's Dean and Global College Quality Assurance.

## Student Onboarding, Payments & Security
- **Self-Service Accounts**: Students, tutors, and schools can create and manage portal accounts at `https://globalcollege.edu/login`.
- **Payment Processing**: Direct integration with Paystack supporting international Visa, Mastercard, Verve, and Mobile Money.
- **DRM & Integrity**: Content protection protocols prevent unauthorized ripping, securing faculty intellectual property and proprietary lecture streams.

## Community Education & Sponsorship Foundation (Donation Program)
Global College operates a dedicated **Community Education & Sponsorship Foundation** (`https://globalcollege.edu/donate`) funded by individual benefactors, alumni, and philanthropic partners:
- **Core Mission**: Direct financial intervention for underprivileged, orphaned, and vulnerable children who cannot afford formal education.
- **Direct Physical Institution Enrollment**: When accumulated donation funds for a sponsored student reach the required financial threshold, Global College directly pays the tuition and admission fees to place the child into an **accredited brick-and-mortar physical school, high school, or technical college**, providing uniforms, books, and examination fees.
- **Virtual Vocational Sponsorship**: Needy youth who can access online hubs are sponsored with free tuition, hardware, and mobile data bundles to complete high-income digital bootcamps (coding, data analytics, computerized accounting).
- **Sole Accepted Gateway**: 100% of donations are transparently processed via Paystack with instant receipting and audit-traceable reference codes.
